title: PlaneMem current durable handoff detail
description: Source-only full current handoff detail and caller permission hints. Current ownership is not an original creation/claim/resume receipt. Register session-activity-read.json alongside this resource.
$comment: Runtime additionally checks exact target/scope/trace, source type/id uniqueness and original checkpoint membership, target/claimant equality, real timestamp order and UTF-16/lone-surrogate bounds. No validator/generator/client machine-contract integration or execution evidence.

time.$comment: Normalized toISOString output including extended years. Input parser accepts <=128 UTF-16 finite Date.parse text and normalizes it; output pattern alone does not establish calendar validity or chronology.

source.description: Handoff parser normalizes sources to four public fields, dropping extensions. Strings only nonempty with no URI/type allowlist or individual length bound. No source existence/visibility/freshness checks.

detail.description: Durable wcp_session_handoffs record linked to original checkpoint/current parent session; no legacy wcp_handoffs projection substitution. Scope matches request, all name fields <=1024 UTF-16/no controls/DEL/lone surrogates, no ULID requirement for scope/names. open version1/no claimant; claimed or expired version>=2; claimed requires client but old records may omit actor. expired may retain or omit claimant. If target and claimant present they must match. updated_at>=created_at; no wall-clock expiry inference. Sources unique by type/id and contain original checkpoint ID. No notes, pack body, request key or embedded receipt.

permissions.description: write_sessions=verified identity AND (admin OR session.write); claim=write_sessions OR (verified identity AND handoff.claim). Hints ignore current target/status/ownership/version and future Policy/OPA. Either true requires outer identity; false/false allowed with or without identity.

envelope.description: Current trace and sole requested handoff source, complete data, current optional verified identity and hints. Identity scope equals request/data; SDK getHandoff uses full parser without expectedIdentity so does not pin actor/client. No outer scope/version/ETag. Record trace is saved metadata and may differ from outer current trace. No dedicated full-response byte/deadline guarantee.
